fusions.name: Driven Into the Pen
fusions.desc: A shoving butt that deals 12 damage, knocks the target back 3 tiles, leaves it 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds and [Pinned] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Rattling the Stall
fusions.desc: Kicks out at every enemy within 2 tiles, dealing 4 damage. Its damage rises 8% for every 10% of your health already gone (max 40%).

fusions.name: Gate Swung Shut
fusions.desc: Swings a pen gate 5 tiles long across the ground for 6 seconds. Nothing crosses it.

fusions.name: Rail by Rail
fusions.desc: Every time you land a hit, a stack builds on that enemy, up to 10. Your next critical hit on it spends them all: a blow strikes it for 24% of your weapon damage per stack. Unfed, a stack fades every 4 seconds.
